articleFields.title: exact published article title or null until verified
articleFields.author: exact published author/byline or null until verified
articleFields.date: publication date or null until verified
articleFields.url: canonical published article URL or null until verified
articleFields.image: verified RARE Revolution article image path or source URL, or null until verified
articleFields.titlePageAsset: authoritative series title-page asset path in Joliel21/RRM/main

rules: Do not invent missing title, author, date, URL, or image metadata.
Use exact published metadata when verified.
Use the image used by RARE Revolution for the article whenever verified.
Add new articles to the matching series articles.json inventory first.
Title-page artwork remains under series/rare-insights/ and is referenced by manifest.json.
Travel Series is part of the approved 15-series structure and must not be removed.
Clickable behavior belongs in the magazine hotspot/link layer, not in artwork files.
